rules:
If a lead asks anything about cost/price (any variation: "how much", "what's the price", "is it expensive", "what do you charge"), do NOT answer with a number and do NOT let it pull you off-script.

→ Reply: "We have different types of packages so it really comes down to what would be the absolute best fit for you" — then immediately continue with the next scripted message. Keep control of the flow; never hand it to the lead.

Exception (important): If the next scripted message already handles the price question on its own (e.g. it says packages exist / the head coach will walk them through it), then SKIP the deflection line and just send the next scripted message as-is. Don't stack two price answers back-to-back — that's redundant.

Rule of thumb: deflect only if the next message would otherwise leave the price question hanging. If the script already covers it, the script wins.
